Messages.Author: Nikolaj "Lord of the Betrayers" Wendt
Messages.Body:
If wormwood is in play and has reduced all vampires to capacity 3 and
someone plays Fourth Cycle, does Wormwood burn before (and therefore
put everyone back at their original capacity) the "send all vampires
with capacity 3 or less to torpor" effect from Fourth cycle?

Fourth Cycle, The
Event. Requires at least two Gehenna cards in play. When this card is
played, burn all Gehenna cards and conviction cards, and send all
vampires with capacity 3 or less to torpor. No Gehenna cards may be
played while this card remains in play.
